How to play: open the tutorial lessons
To win, chart your path with your dice to reach the enemy camp
You can also win by defeating 4 enemy creatures in duels
If you fail a dice roll, a bonus die is offered for the next one. You can keep two and roll them together!
A deck has 10 dice. Each copy can only appear once in it; however, you can reuse it in your other decks.
A win in Quick game mode with classic rules earns you 30 Bubbles!
A defeat in Quick game or Play mode earns you 5 Bubbles.
Your creature appears on the tile marked with a golden edge on its die's diagram.
You can tap the current tip to move on to the next one!
Click or tap a creature in play to see its attack power and element. This can be useful…
A higher-level die placed on an enemy creature crushes it!
Every day, the Daily die gives you 30 Bubbles, and even 100 on the 7th day!
A deck can contain at most 1 divine die, 2 legendary, 2 Energy dice and 4 rare.
Elemental dice are placed without rolling: perfect for extending a path toward the enemy camp.
Dice of the terrain's element gain +1 attack: choose your terrain carefully! (Autumn: Earth and Wind; Christmas: Lightning, Ice and Fire.)
Complete chapter 3 of the Story to earn the Lucky Ring: a bonus die at the start of every duel against the AI. Other equipped items are earned through challenges (Options › Equipped item).
Note your recovery code (Options › Save) to restore your progress on another phone.
The Announcements die shows you the game's latest news.
Tap your level, top right, to see your daily and weekly quests.
Each level earns Bubbles, and levels 5 and 10 unlock new bonus die effects.
Multi-element creatures count for all summoning quests, whatever the requested element.
Too many copies of the same die? Recycle your duplicates into Bubbles from the Collection.
Synergies: certain linked characters gain +1 attack when together on the board. Check your creatures' cards!
At the Pink Lake, watch for the sacred lily: the creature placed on it gains +1 strength until the next turn.
On the Sky Island, lightning strikes two random tiles each turn: don't bet everything on a single creature!
In the Winds of Hacko, a small tornado can carry a creature and its tile elsewhere: don't bet everything on a single route!
No network? The game launches offline. To keep everything on your device: Options › Save › Download the whole game.
A creature's strength is that of the tile where it stops: before attacking, end your move on your best tile.
When a creature enters the enemy camp, its whole path disappears with it, and the creatures placed on it too. Keep a backup route!
Neighbor bonus: a tile gains +1 if a neighboring tile carries the element it dominates. Place your dice accordingly.

If all your dice show the same face, the summon always succeeds, even below the required result! The required result is shown on each die: 2+ common, 3+ uncommon, 4+ rare, 4+ legendary (2 dice) and 5+ divine (2 dice).
Tie in a fight? Both creatures disappear and each camp counts one defeated enemy.
On the Road to Forfalla, your creatures slide to the end of the free tiles: an enemy on the road stops them… and triggers the fight.
In the Scorched Lands, the magma vents are impassable: they cut roads and block placements.
In a hurry? The ⏩ button at the top of the game (or Options › Game) enables fast turns: the AI, rolls and fights go faster.
On computer, press Space to roll the die you just placed, or to confirm a move.
The History button, at the top of the game, retraces every roll and every fight with each camp's strengths.
The Pouch button, during the game, shows the dice you still have to draw: useful to prepare your next turns.
In Collection, tap a die to open its card: unfolded shape, synergies and 3D character.
Options › Dice & pouch: choose the style of your roll dice and the color, texture and cord of your pouch.
Sudden death! Three 6s with three dice, or four 6s with four dice, and the game is won on the spot.
Selected a creature by mistake? Tap it again, or tap another tile, to deselect it.
Online PVP: open a table so any player can join you, no code to exchange. Choose Duel (1 vs 1) or 2 vs 2 at the top of the page.
Beginner? Choose the city of Dassom (neutral terrain) and tap "✨ Optimal deck for this terrain" in Play: the game builds your deck for you.
Play mode: choose the board shape (Narrow, Pillars, Hourglass, Two fords) to vary your games.
The city of Dassom and the underground cave are neutral terrains: no element is favored there.
A creature that has just appeared can only move from your next turn.
In My decks, prepare several decks (one per terrain, for example) and choose one before each game.
From level 5, propose your own die from the Collection: if approved, it joins the game with your name!
Challenges › Tavern Tales: write a role-playing scene, it may be played and told in the podcast!
Beginner? "How to play" offers 4 one-minute lessons: placing a die, crossing the terrain, fights, affinities. You can replay each lesson whenever you want.
Double click (computer) or double tap (smartphone) on a creature on the board: its card opens right away.
2 vs 2: two teams of two play in turn. Victory: 3 crossings or 6 fights for the team. Offline as well as online, AIs can complete the team.
A multi-element die (Lathandre, Shauntéa, Jordan, the Great White Spider…) always receives the terrain bonus, but never the neighbor bonus.
Jordan, Bolduc's steed, gains +1 AP per allied Bolduc on the board (2 at most). Remember to put it in the same deck!
Effect dice: one tile less, but a power (+1 AP depending on the situation). Read the die's card to learn its effect.
Card dice: placed without rolling, they leave an ice wall (blocks 3 turns) or a trap invisible to the opponent in place of a creature.
Class dice: the healer takes back a lost tile, the scout reveals the opponent's hand for 2 turns.
Equipped items (Options › Equipped item): only one at a time. Lucky Ring, Snow Bell, Golden Leaf, Miner's Lantern, Kayla's Scarf or Bottomless Bag, earned through challenges.
Shop: 0.8% chance of getting a divine die per die drawn. A guarantee gives you a divine every 80 pouches without a divine, and a legendary every 50 pouches without a legendary.
The element wheel is to the right of the board: move the view to see it. Water dominates fire, fire ice, ice earth, earth wind, wind lightning, lightning water.
Crackling dice are extremely rare: will you manage to complete their collection?
A Max, Orcus, Eberien… die exists in several versions (legendary, silver, gold): check the Collection to find them all, grouped by character.

XP: victory 40 (up to 60 against a hard AI), defeat 15, Story 50, PVP 80. Each level earns Bubbles, and every 5 levels a +100 bonus.

A wooded clearing crossed by a river, ferns and butterflies.
A basalt arena surrounded by lava and smoking volcanoes.
Fire dice gain +1. Six magma vents are impassable.
An ice road toward the gate of Forfalla, under the aurora borealis.
Ice dice gain +1. Creatures slide to the end of the free tiles; an opponent stops their run and triggers a fight.
A green high plateau, windmills, sheep and kites.
Wind dice gain +1. Each turn, a small tornado carries a creature and its tile elsewhere.
A clear mountain lake on a bed of pink pebbles.
Water dice gain +1. Each turn, a sacred lily gives +1 strength for two turns.
A floating sanctuary above a sea of stormy clouds.
Lightning dice gain +1. Each turn, lightning strikes two random tiles.
The cobbled main square of Dassom, between half-timbered houses and market stalls.
Neutral terrain: no element is favored, only dice and strategy count.
An underground hall lit by torches, crystals and glowing mushrooms.
A golden clearing under the maples, pumpkins and falling leaves.
Seasonal terrain: Earth and Wind dice gain +1.
The great fir lights up under the aurora, among snowy chalets and fireworks.
Christmas event: Lightning, Ice and Fire dice gain +1. Each turn, a gift falls from the sky and gives +1 strength for two turns. Exclusive challenges and rewards!

An AI ally plays with you against two opponents. Victory: 3 crossings or 6 fights.
Defeat: +5 Bubbles whatever the difficulty. The AI's rolls follow the same luck as yours; the stronger it is, the better it thinks. The Divine AI also plays with a more powerful deck.
